blocks: עֹמֶדֶת לָעַד מִשְׁפְּטֵי־יְהוָה אֱמֶת צָדְקוּ יַחְדָּו:
הַנֶּחֱמָדִים מִזָּהָב וּמִפַּז רָב וּמְתוּקִים מִדְּבַשׁ וְנֹפֶת צוּפִים:
גַּם־עַבְדְּךָ נִזְהָר בָּהֶם בְּשָׁמְרָם עֵקֶב רָב:
שְׁגִיאוֹת מִי־יָבִין מִנִּסְתָּרוֹת נַקֵּנִי:
גַּם מִזֵּדִים חֲשֹׂךְ עַבְדֶּךָ אַל־יִמְשְׁלוּ־בִי אָז אֵיתָם וְנִקֵּיתִי מִפֶּשַׁע רָב:
יִהְיוּ לְרָצוֹן אִמְרֵי־פִי וְהֶגְיוֹן לִבִּי לְפָנֶיךָ יְהוָה צוּרִי וְגֹאֲלִי:
לְדָוִד בְּשַׁנּוֹתוֹ אֶת־טַעְמוֹ לִפְנֵי אֲבִימֶלֶךְ וַיְגָרְשֵׁהוּ וַיֵּלַךְ:
אֲבָרְכָה אֶת־יְהוָה בְּכָל־עֵת תָּמִיד תְּהִלָּתוֹ בְּפִי:
בַּיהוָה תִּתְהַלֵּל נַפְשִׁי יִשְׁמְעוּ עֲנָוִים וְיִשְׂמָחוּ:
גַּדְּלוּ לַיהוָה אִתִּי וּנְרוֹמְמָה שְׁמוֹ יַחְדָּו:
דָּרַשְׁתִּי אֶת־יְהוָה וְעָנָנִי וּמִכָּל־מְגוּרוֹתַי הִצִּילָנִי:
הִבִּיטוּ אֵלָיו וְנָהָרוּ וּפְנֵיהֶם אַל־יֶחְפָּרוּ:
זֶה עָנִי קָרָא וַיהוָה שָׁמֵעַ וּמִכָּל־צָרוֹתָיו הוֹשִׁיעוֹ:
חֹנֶה מַלְאַךְ־יְהוָה סָבִיב לִירֵאָיו וַיְחַלְּצֵם:
טַעֲמוּ וּרְאוּ כִּי־טוֹב יְהוָה אַשְׁרֵי הַגֶּבֶר יֶחֱסֶה־בּוֹ:
יְראוּ אֶת־יְהוָה קְדֹשָׁיו כִּי אֵין מַחְסוֹר לִירֵאָיו:
כְּפִירִים רָשׁוּ וְרָעֵבוּ וְדֹרְשֵׁי יְהוָה לֹא־יַחְסְרוּ כָל־טוֹב:
לְכוּ־בָנִים שִׁמְעוּ־לִי יִרְאַת יְהוָה אֲלַמֶּדְכֶם:
מִי־הָאִישׁ הֶחָפֵץ חַיִּים אֹהֵב יָמִים לִרְאוֹת טוֹב:
נְצֹר לְשׁוֹנְךָ מֵרָע וּשְׂפָתֶיךָ מִדַּבֵּר מִרְמָה:
סוּר מֵרָע וַעֲשֵׂה־טוֹב בַּקֵּשׁ שָׁלוֹם וְרָדְפֵהוּ:
עֵינֵי יְהוָה אֶל־צַדִּיקִים וְאָזְנָיו אֶל־שַׁוְעָתָם:
פְּנֵי יְהוָה בְּעֹשֵׂי רָע לְהַכְרִית מֵאֶרֶץ זִכְרָם:

the Lord are truth, together just, they are more precious than gold, even than an abundance of refined gold, and sweeter than honey and the honeycomb. Your servant, too, is careful about them, for keeping them there is great reward. As for errors, who understands, cleanse me from hidden sins. From the arrogant, too, keep away Thy servant — let them not rule over me; then will I be without fault and clear of grave offence. May the words of my mouth be pleasing and the meditation of my heart before Thee, O Lord my Rock and my Redeemer.

By David when he disguised his sanity before Abimelech, who drove him away and he went: I will at all times bless the Lord, His fame shall always be in my mouth. My soul glories in the Lord, let the humble hear and rejoice. Magnify the Lord with me and let us exalt His Name together. I sought the Lord, and He answered me and saved me from all my terrors. When they look to Him, they are radiant and their faces are not shamed. This man called and the Lord hears and from all his troubles did He save him. An angel of the Lord encamps around those that fear Him and rescued them. Observe and perceive that the Lord is good, fortunate the man who trusts in Him. Fear the Lord, O His holy ones, for there is no want among those that fear Him. Though whelps may hunger and starve, those that seek the Lord will not lack all that is good. Come, children, listen to me, the fear of the Lord will I teach you. Who is the man that desires life, who longs for days to see goodness? Keep your tongue from evil and your lips from speaking guile, depart from evil and do good, seek peace and pursue it. The eyes of the Lord are towards the righteous and His ears to their cry. The countenance of the Lord is against evil-doers to cut off their memory from the earth. Men cry out and the Lord
צָעֲקוּ וַיהוָה שָׁמֵעַ וּמִכָּל־צָרוֹתָם הִצִּילָם:
קָרוֹב יְהוָה לְנִשְׁבְּרֵי־לֵב וְאֶת־דַּכְּאֵי־רוּחַ יוֹשִׁיעַ:
רַבּוֹת רָעוֹת צַדִּיק וּמִכֻּלָּם יַצִּילֶנּוּ יְהוָה:
שֹׁמֵר כָּל־עַצְמוֹתָיו אַחַת מֵהֵנָּה לֹא נִשְׁבָּרָה:
תְּמוֹתֵת רָשָׁע רָעָה וְשֹׂנְאֵי צַדִּיק יֶאְשָׁמוּ:
פּוֹדֶה יְהוָה נֶפֶשׁ עֲבָדָיו וְלֹא יֶאְשְׁמוּ כָּל־הַחֹסִים בּוֹ:
תְּפִלָּה לְמֹשֶׁה אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים אֲדֹנָי מָעוֹן אַתָּה הָיִיתָ לָּנוּ בְּדֹר וָדֹר:
בְּטֶרֶם הָרִים יֻלָּדוּ וַתְּחוֹלֵל אֶרֶץ וְתֵבֵל וּמֵעוֹלָם עַד־עוֹלָם אַתָּה אֵל:
תָּשֵׁב אֱנוֹשׁ עַד־דַּכָּא וַתֹּאמֶר שׁוּבוּ בְנֵי־אָדָם:
כִּי אֶלֶף שָׁנִים בְּעֵינֶיךָ כְּיוֹם אֶתְמוֹל כִּי יַעֲבֹר וְאַשְׁמוּרָה בַלָּיְלָה:
זְרַמְתָּם שֵׁנָה יִהְיוּ בַּבֹּקֶר כֶּחָצִיר יַחֲלֹף:
בַּבֹּקֶר יָצִיץ וְחָלָף לָעֶרֶב יְמוֹלֵל וְיָבֵשׁ:
כִּי־כָלִינוּ בְאַפֶּךָ וּבַחֲמָתְךָ נִבְהָלְנוּ:
שַׁתָּה עֲוֹנֹתֵינוּ לְנֶגְדֶּךָ עֲלֻמֵנוּ לִמְאוֹר פָּנֶיךָ:
כִּי כָל־יָמֵינוּ פָּנוּ בְעֶבְרָתֶךָ כִּלִּינוּ שָׁנֵינוּ כְמוֹ־הֶגֶה:
יְמֵי שְׁנוֹתֵינוּ בָהֶם שִׁבְעִים שָׁנָה וְאִם בִּגְבוּרֹת שְׁמֹנִים שָׁנָה וְרָהְבָּם עָמָל וָאָוֶן כִּי גָז חִישׁ וַנָּעֻפָה:
מִי־יוֹדֵעַ עֹז אַפֶּךָ וּכְיִרְאָתְךָ עֶבְרָתֶךָ:
לִמְנוֹת יָמֵינוּ כֵּן הוֹדַע וְנָבִא לְבַב חָכְמָה:
שׁוּבָה יְהוָה עַד־מָתָי וְהִנָּחֵם עַל־עֲבָדֶיךָ:
שַׂבְּעֵנוּ בַבֹּקֶר חַסְדֶּךָ וּנְרַנְּנָה וְנִשְׂמְחָה בְּכָל־יָמֵינוּ:
שַׂמְּחֵנוּ כִּימוֹת עִנִּיתָנוּ שְׁנוֹת רָאִינוּ רָעָה:
יֵרָאֶה אֶל־עֲבָדֶיךָ פָעֳלֶךָ וַהֲדָרְךָ עַל־בְּנֵיהֶם:
וִיהִי נֹעַם אֲדֹנָי אֱלֹהֵינוּ עָלֵינוּ וּמַעֲשֵׂה יָדֵינוּ כּוֹנְנָה עָלֵינוּ וּמַעֲשֵׂה יָדֵינוּ כּוֹנְנֵהוּ:
יוֹשֵׁב בְּסֵתֶר עֶלְיוֹן בְּצֵל שַׁדַּי יִתְלוֹנָן:
אֹמַר לַיהוָה

listens and He delivered them from all their troubles. The Lord is near the broken-hearted, and those whose spirit is crushed, does He save. Many are the sufferings of the righteous man but from all of them will the Lord deliver him. He guards all his bones, not one of them is broken. Evil slays the wicked; they that hate the righteous shall be found guilty. The Lord redeems the soul of His servants, and all who trust in Him shall not be found guilty.

The Prayer of Moses the man of God: Lord, Thou hast been a dwelling for us in every generation. Before the mountains were born and Thou didst bring forth the earth and the world, from eternity to eternity Thou art God. Thou dost restore mortals to contrition and say: Return, children of men. For a thousand years are in Thine eyes as a yesterday that passes and as a watch in the night. Thou hast carried them off: they are in sleep; in the morning he is renewed like grass. In the morning it blossoms and is renewed, in the evening it withers and dries. For we are consumed through Thine anger and terrified through Thy wrath. Thou hast placed our sins before Thee, our secret transgressions before the light of Thy countenance. For all our days pass away through Thine anger, we end our years like a fleeing thought. The days of our years — they are seventy years or, at full strength, eighty years; and their pride is toil and sorrow, since swiftly severed do we fly away. Who knows the might of Thine anger and is Thy wrath according to the fear of Thee? To count our days teach us well so that we may acquire a wise heart. Turn again, O Lord — how much longer — and take pity on Thy servants. Satisfy us in the morning with Thy grace that we may exult and rejoice all our days. Cause us to rejoice as long as the days when Thou didst afflict us and the years when we saw misfortune. Let Thy work become apparent to Thy servants, and Thy splendour to their children; and may the favour of the Lord our God be upon us; and firmly establish the work of our hands for us, the work of our hands, establish it firmly.
As one who sits in the protection of the Most High and shelters in the shadow of the Almighty, I say to
מַחְסִי וּמְצוּדָתִי אֱלֹהַי אֶבְטַח־בּוֹ:
כִּי הוּא יַצִּילְךָ מִפַּח יָקוּשׁ מִדֶּבֶר הַוּוֹת:
בְּאֶבְרָתוֹ יָסֶךְ לָךְ וְתַחַת כְּנָפָיו תֶּחְסֶה צִנָּה וְסֹחֵרָה אֲמִתּוֹ:
לֹא־תִירָא מִפַּחַד לָיְלָה מֵחֵץ יָעוּף יוֹמָם:
מִדֶּבֶר בָּאֹפֶל יַהֲלֹךְ מִקֶּטֶב יָשׁוּד צָהֳרָיִם:
יִפֹּל מִצִּדְּךָ אֶלֶף וּרְבָבָה מִימִינֶךָ אֵלֶיךָ לֹא יִגָּשׁ:
רַק בְּעֵינֶיךָ תַבִּיט וְשִׁלֻּמַת רְשָׁעִים תִּרְאֶה:
כִּי־אַתָּה יְהוָה מַחְסִי עֶלְיוֹן שַׂמְתָּ מְעוֹנֶךָ:
לֹא־תְאֻנֶּה אֵלֶיךָ רָעָה וְנֶגַע לֹא־יִקְרַב בְּאָהֳלֶךָ:
כִּי מַלְאָכָיו יְצַוֶּה־לָּךְ לִשְׁמָרְךָ בְּכָל דְּרָכֶיךָ:
עַל־כַּפַּיִם יִשָּׂאוּנְךָ פֶּן־תִּגֹּף בָּאֶבֶן רַגְלֶךָ:
עַל־שַׁחַל וָפֶתֶן תִּדְרֹךְ תִּרְמֹס כְּפִיר וְתַנִּין:
כִּי בִי חָשַׁק וַאֲפַלְּטֵהוּ אֲשַׂגְּבֵהוּ כִּי־יָדַע שְׁמִי:
יִקְרָאֵנִי וְאֶעֱנֵהוּ עִמּוֹ אָנֹכִי בְצָרָה אֲחַלְּצֵהוּ וַאֲכַבְּדֵהוּ:
אֹרֶךְ יָמִים אַשְׂבִּיעֵהוּ וְאַרְאֵהוּ בִּישׁוּעָתִי:
אֹרֶךְ יָמִים אַשְׂבִּיעֵהוּ וְאַרְאֵהוּ בִּישׁוּעָתִי:

the Lord: My refuge and my fortress, my God in whom I trust. For He saves you from the snare of the fowler, from destructive plague. With His wing He covers you, you shelter under His wings, His faithfulness is shield and buckler. You shall not fear the terror of night, the arrow that flies by day, the plague that creeps in the dark, the pestilence that flares up at noon. Though a thousand fall at your side and ten thousand on your right, to you it will not approach. You need only look with your eyes and you will see the recompense of the wicked. For Thou, O Lord, art my trust — on high hast Thou placed Thy dwelling. No misfortune will befall you, no plague will come near your tent. For He will command His angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways. On hands will they bear you lest your foot be bruised by a stone. Though you tread on the lion and viper and trample on the whelp and the crocodile. For because he delighted in Me I delivered him; I shall raise him up because he acknowledged my Name. When he calls me, I will answer him, I am with him in distress, I save him and honour him. With length of days will I satisfy him and I will let him see my salvation.
